_evidence: 0x0052848b scans the 8 records of 0x1c bytes at 0x81cd91..0x81ce71: 'cmp dword [eax],ebx; jne' then 'mov edx,[eax+4]; cmp dword [edx],ecx'. The key +0 is drawn from 0..3 and -1 (the spec draws ebx from 0..3, so matching and non-matching keys and several matches per table occur), +4 is a pointer to a fresh 4-byte cell (key_0052848b) for every record: a record whose key matches is dereferenced unchecked, so a live record always carries a valid pointer (zero image data would fault). Nothing else of the records is read.
